title: Signed-input size policy with scripted clarification
description: Ambiguous security requirement whose public semantics are supplied by a shared user oracle.

acceptanceCriteria.description: All serializer variants expose the clarified keyword-only max_input_size API with strict argument validation.
All four load entry points reject oversized complete tokens before expensive processing with PayloadTooLarge.
Boundary, Unicode-byte, inheritance, unsafe-method, exception-export, and default-unlimited semantics match the oracle.
Typing and the upstream regression suite remain correct.
